unsupported_wording: Title in claim ('BC Court of Appeal clarifies BCUC jurisdiction') is the URL slug, not the printed title ('Family Ties: BC Court of Appeal Confirms BC Utilities Commission Jurisdiction over Affiliate Electricity Sales'). Day of March not printed. 'Separate person' supported; the explicit conclusion 'so supplying it is not self-supply' is an inference from the quoted holdings, not a verbatim sentence.
note: Authors Tariq Ahmed and Niall Rand. Case: Powell River Energy Inc. v. British Columbia (Utilities Commission). Quotes: 'each corporation in PREI's corporate group was a distinct legal entity and therefore a separate "person" under the statute'; Self-supply Exclusion 'covers supply either: (i) supply to oneself; or (ii) to one's employees or tenants.'
